children: On October 9, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that it failed to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) after 30 consecutive business days below $1.00. There is no immediate impact; the company has 180 days, until April 7, 2027, to regain compliance, with a possible additional 180 days if it meets certain criteria, including a potential reverse split.
